# crosswork_device_groups (Resource)

This resource can manage a device group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_device_groups" "example" {
  name        = "cwtest-device-group"
  description = "Test device group"
  parent_uuid = "260cc7e9-3425-425c-b29d-9b573a5240b9"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name, unique among the groups under the same parent
- `parent_uuid` (String) Id of the parent group; use the id of the `All Locations` group, the group of the `crosswork_groupings` data source that is built in (`discovery_type` is `StaticSystem`) and allows subgroups (`subgroups_allowed`), or the id of another device group

### Optional

- `description` (String) Group description
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_device_groups.example "<id>"
```
